title: RCSE v1.3.1 - consequence alignment and repeated vendor holdouts
description: Reproducible selective-execution study including twenty consequence-permutation assignments across twenty calibration splits, ten cold-start vendor holdouts with concentration measures, PO-grouped policy and selection contrasts, component loss comparisons and refreshed tail diagnostics. Includes the preceding all-eligible 210692-case study and outputs. Manuscripts, reviewer correspondence, document-editing helpers and credentials are excluded. Original code is MIT licensed; source-data attribution remains CC BY 4.0.
